title: The records level 0 reads from tool output
description: The two record kinds level 0 writes from a tool's result (docs/memory-v2.md, "Tool output"), as members of a records list (defs.schema.json#/$defs/observation). Source: memory/extract/output.go (outputRecords, emitValues, valueContent, ValueParts), lisp/src/output.lisp.

valueRecord.description: One exact value tool output printed (ledger.KindValue): target is kind:value, the kind one of extract.ValueKinds and the value its raw spelling; content is the kind, a space and the value, with " (seen N times)" when N results printed it; sourceEntryIds are the entry it was first seen in and, when another, the latest; it supersedes the value's earlier record.

evidenceRecord.description: At most eight verbatim lines of a tool result that failed or matched a failure grammar (ledger.KindEvidence): content is the tool, its quoted target (clipped) and " output: " then the lines (each at most 160 characters) joined by " ⏎ "; tool and target are the call's, as its attempt's; sourceEntryIds are the call's entry and its result's.
